description: Executable bindings for strict-suite cases. Every step is a real command. precondition_steps establish the catalog's declared preconditions; when one fails the case is recorded as blocked and the body is not executed. assertion_map records which step establishes each catalog assertion and is the basis for source_target_trace_coverage.

steps.note: the orchestrator's success path ends in a correct refusal; this probe asserts the refusal machinery and exits zero only when every control holds
